name: PSP_MOCKUP
description: I came across a photo of someone's PSP on their desk surrounded by random items, and it really stuck with me. So when I was working on a batch of edits inspired by the game Red Dead Redemption, I knew i had to combine the two ideas together.

name: SONY_EDIT
description: One of my favorite edits I made, was a part of a bigger project where we aimed to capture the vibe of old Sony product ads from the late 90s and early 2000s.
